key_insight: Earlier RL checkpoints retain complementary agent capabilities that the best-validation checkpoint has lost, and targeted distillation can recover them.
engineering_relevance: Retaining checkpoints turns a completed RL run into a reusable teacher pool for post-training capability recovery without additional teacher training.
method: Use the best-validation checkpoint as the student and saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates.
Highest Coverage Next dynamically selects teachers that best cover the student's currently unsolved problems.
Locality-Aware Distillation restricts transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better.
evidence_signal: Across five agentic domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, the abstract reports gains of up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search.
watch_item: The teacher pool requires no additional training, but checkpoint storage, teacher evaluation, and distillation still add costs that need practical assessment.
paper_title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
